title: Need for Speed™ Hot Pursuit Remastered
notes: Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit Remastered (Steam version) ran perfectly in my testing on a MacBook Pro M4 (10-core GPU, 16 GB RAM) with macOS 27. Setup: a Highball bottle (Windows 10, CrossOver 26.3 engine) with Steam and the EA app installed, the DXMT renderer, and sync set to none. The game installed, launched and played without any tweaks, at the default maximum resolution and 60 fps.
